summary: Table of masking examples: in-place masking, masking within longer words, adjacent and overlapping matches merging, separated matches getting separate placeholders, repeats merging, nested matches, and every occurrence of short secrets.
questions: Can you show examples of how secret masking behaves?
What happens when two secrets are next to each other in output?

answer_card.title: Secret masking examples
answer_card.answer_md:
- `abcd` in `password=abcd` gives `password=$REDACTED$`
- `abcd` in `abcdef` gives `$REDACTED$ef`
- `abcd`+`efgh` in `xabcdefghx` gives `x$REDACTED$x` (adjacent merge)
- `abcd`+`efgh` in `xabcd efghx` gives `x$REDACTED$ $REDACTED$x`
- `0000` in `a000000b` gives `a$REDACTED$b`
- `a` in `banana` gives `b$REDACTED$n$REDACTED$n$REDACTED$`
